# Region Syddanmark — Syddanmark

**Region Syddanmark** (the administrative organization) and **Syddanmark** (the geographic region) represent the same regional healthcare authority within the Danish psychiatric system. In the context of the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]], the two names are used interchangeably to track diagnostic and treatment pathways for children and adolescents with ADHD. The region encompasses several key child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinics, including facilities in [[aabennraa-bupa]], [[odense-bupa]], and [[vejle-bupa]] [^src2].

## Clinical Operations and Patient Volume
Region Syddanmark manages a substantial patient volume, contributing data for both the [[adhd-udredningspopulation]] (diagnostic population) and the [[adhd-behandlingspopulation]] (treatment population) [^src6]. In the 2023/24 reporting period, the region recorded 1,171 diagnostic pathways and 841 patients in package treatment pathways [^src6]. The region also participates in national tracking of clinical markers, though there are significant regional differences across Denmark in the usage of the [[agx01b]] pathway marker [^src7].

## Performance on Quality Indicators
The region's performance on the national quality indicators highlights both areas of structural strength and ongoing challenges, with results often contrasting sharply with other regions like [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]].

- **[[indikator-1|Indikator 1]]**: Syddanmark maintained a stable result of 62% [^src14].
- **[[indikator-2a|Indikator 2a]]**: The region achieved a 91% fulfillment rate (48 out of 53 cases) in 2023/24 [^src1], and followed this with an 88% fulfillment rate in 2024/25 [^src9].
- **[[indikator-2b|Indikator 2b]]**: In 2023/24, Region Syddanmark led the country with a 77% fulfillment rate, while other regions languished at 31% [^src2] [^src3]. In 2024/25, the region scored 70%, again outperforming regions like Region Sjælland, which scored 32% [^src9] [^src15].
- **[[indikator-3|Indikator 3]]**: The region reported the lowest performance in 2023/24 at just 10% [^src4]. However, it saw a notable increase to 26% in 2024/25 [^src15].
- **[[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]**: Performance was recorded at 7% in 2023/24 [^src5], and the region remained the lowest in 2024/25 with a 9% score [^src10].
- **[[indikator-6|Indikator 6]]**: Syddanmark recorded the second-highest medication rate among all regions at 72% [^src10].
- **[[indikator-9|Indikator 9]]**: Psychotherapy was assessed as relevant for fewer than three patients in total within the region [^src16].
- **[[indikator-10|Indikator 10]]**: No regions, including Syddanmark, managed to fulfill this indicator overall [^src11].
- **[[indikator-11|Indikator 11]]**: The region recorded the second-lowest score at 67% [^src12].

## Administrative Engagement
Administratively, Region Syddanmark maintains a passive feedback posture regarding the national database reports. For both the 2023/24 and 2024/25 reporting cycles, the organization officially reported having no comments on the annual reports [^src7] [^src13].
